description: This Java source file defines the LogFragment class, a fragment that contains a LogView and manages log display within an Android application. It handles view creation, layout setup, and text change events to keep the log view scrolled to the bottom.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays a log view and manages its layout and behavior.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, setting layout parameters, styles, and padding.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view hierarchy, sets up a TextWatcher to auto-scroll the log view when text changes.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance contained within the fragment.
